question: RKSK (Rashtriya Kishor Swasthya Karyakram), India's national adolescent health programme, was launched in 2014 and covers the age group 10–19 years.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. RKSK was launched in 2014 and covers adolescents aged 10–19 years across six health-behaviour domains including nutrition, sexual and reproductive health, substance abuse, mental health, injuries, and NCDs.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. RKSK was launched in 2014, replacing the earlier Adolescent Reproductive and Sexual Health (ARSH) strategy. It covers 10–19 years and operates through Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics (AFHCs) at sub-district and CHC levels.
